final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), shares AS (SELECT gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts) SELECT gender, order_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS share_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
